claims: As of early April 2026, over 3.1 million bottles of various eye drops have been voluntarily recalled by K.C. Pharmaceuticals.
The recall by K.C. Pharmaceuticals is due to potential lack of assurance of sterility.
The recalled products were sold at CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Walmart, and H-E-B.
The recalled products include various Dry Eye Relief and Artificial Tears products.

Brands affected by the recall include Best Choice, Careone, CVS Health, Equaline, Foster & Thrive, Good Neighbor Pharmacy, H-E-B, Leader, Major, Meijer, QC-Quality Choice, Rite Aid, TopCare Health, and Walgreens.
The recall includes products with expiration dates ranging from April 30 to July 31, 2026.
The FDA classified this as a Class II recall.
No injuries or infections have been reported to date.
